status: Comparison policy; no external accuracy run launched
user_preference: Use verified published benchmark numbers; reproduce missing evaluations rather than rerunning all third-party baselines.
published_rows: Record source, table, version, backbone, split, metric and memory interval; separate published and local measurements. A missing value does not prove no publication exists.
reuse: Do not automatically rerun SAMURAI, SAM2Long, Efficient-SAM2 or Lean-SAM2 where the required evaluation is published. Prefer compatible released predictions for missing Dice or sequence statistics.
new_measurements: Our regional adapter and parameter-matched global control need new evaluation.
A native reference is missing if compatible predictions or Dice/sequence statistics are unavailable for our exact checkpoint and protocol.
Run a third-party method only for an actually missing comparison after documenting searched sources and the intended setup.
engineering: Retain native replay, mask/bank alignment, multi-object isolation, source/checkpoint checks and evaluator tests; these are not duplicate full-cohort reproduction.
statistics: J&F is not Dice. Aggregate mean IoU/J&F cannot provide mean Dice or paired sequence tests and confidence intervals.
checkpoint: Recent PolypGen MedSAM2_latest.pt results cannot inherit standard SAM2 published scores.
